caveats.text: If your journey avoids Zone 1 and you see a pink card reader when changing trains, touch your contactless or Oyster card on it to pay the right fare.

Fares between two stations may vary depending on the direction of travel, time of day and day of the week.

We charge higher fares at the busiest times of the day (usually between 06:30 and 09:30, and between 16:00 and 19:00, Monday to Friday).

When you pay as you go, you must touch your contactless or Oyster card on a yellow reader at the start and end of your journey.

Some journeys are charged via Zone 1 regardless of the route taken.

If your journey avoids Zone 1 and you see a pink card reader when changing trains, touch your contactless or Oyster card on it to pay the right fare.
The price shown is a single adult pay as you go fare.

stopMessages:
Step-free routes from Liverpool Street to Kings Cross St Pancras and Euston (via Euston Square): For Kings Cross, take a Metropolitan line eastbound train (platform 1) to Aldgate. Stay on the train. After a few minutes, the train reverses and travels westbound: you can get off at Kings Cross step-free. Eastbound journeys from Kings Cross are step-free direct to Liverpool Street. 

For Euston, take a Metropolitan line eastbound train (platform 1) to Aldgate. Stay on the train. After a few minutes, the train reverses and travels westbound and you can get off at Euston Square step-free. It is then a 10 minute step-free walk via the street to Euston. Euston Square is step-free westbound only, so you cannot do the same journey in reverse to return to Liverpool Street. 

Mini ramps are available at Liverpool Street, Kings Cross and Euston Square. To request a mini ramp speak to a member of staff before you start your journey.
